title: Japanese Crepe with Kenyan Kenkey Filling
description: A unique fusion dish blending Japanese crepe with traditional Kenyan kenkey. Crispy crepe wraps tender, slightly acidic kenkey.

ingredients.name: Kenyan kenkey
ingredients.notes: Traditionally made from fermented corn dough

ingredients.name: acidic
ingredients.notes: Lemon juice or vinegar for adding flavor

ingredients.name: tender
ingredients.notes: Softened tofu or scrambled eggs for added texture

instructions: Combine rice flour, acidic, and tender in a bowl.
Heat a non-stick pan and dust it with flour.
Pour crepe batter and cook until edges start to curl.
Place the cooked crepe on a flat surface.
Spread the kenkey mixture on one half of the crepe.
Fold the crepe in half to enclose the filling.
Serve hot with your favorite toppings.
